description: How rare is the COMBINATION of two facets of an idea? Counts projects whose pitch contains all words of facet A AND all words of facet B, plus the latest year such a project appeared. Use it to test claims like 'nobody combined sign language with smart glasses'. Keep each facet to 1-3 words (e.g. facet_a='sign language', facet_b='smart glasses'). both=0 means the combination is unseen in the corpus; compare with each facet alone via originality.crowding_by_year.

configuration.query: FROM {{INDEX}} | WHERE MATCH(pitch, ?facet_a, {"operator": "AND"}) AND MATCH(pitch, ?facet_b, {"operator": "AND"}) | STATS both = COUNT(*), latest = MAX(year)

facet_b.description: Second facet, 1-3 words (e.g. the mechanism or audience).
